Question 3
?

The velocity v of a particle P at time t is given by v(t)=⟨tet,−et,4⟩. Find the tangential component of acceleration at time t.

a
te2t(t2+1)e2t+16
b
(t2+1)e2te2t+16
c
(t+1)e2tt2+16
d
e2tt2+16
e
(t2+t+1)e2t(t2+1)e2t+16
